title: Constitutional Definition Audit
description: Measures definition integrity, scope fidelity, and delegation drift across applied legal or administrative terms. CDA conditions later modules but does not replace the pioneer spine.

definitions.governing_definition: A person engaged in the operation of a commercial motor vehicle in the regulated commercial context.
definitions.applied_definition: Any person using a car on public roads regardless of commercial context.
definitions.notes: Illustrative drift example where a commercial definition is expanded into a general civilian population.

definitions.governing_definition: Vehicle definition bounded by specific commercial or regulated statutory context.
definitions.applied_definition: Any privately used automobile in all contexts.
definitions.notes: Illustrative drift example showing context collapse.

definitions.source_authority: U.S. Constitution Art. I, § 8 and implementing federal law
definitions.governing_definition: Trade, traffic, transportation, and commercial intercourse within the governing constitutional and statutory scope.
definitions.applied_definition: Any movement by any person in any setting.
definitions.notes: Illustrative drift example where movement is collapsed into commerce.
